title: Touch the post, then ring
description: A steel ball hangs in the air at (60, 270), top left, and falls from the start. A short fixed beam, the post, runs level from x = 180 to x = 230 with its top at y = 122. A bell hangs at (340, 80), low on the right, from a bracket 50 cm above it. The build zone covers x from 20 to 380 and y from 20 to 280. The ball has to touch the post before anything touches the bell.
